summaryJa: 2026年2月、（氏名等は秘匿）に対してFBI捜査官がMicrosoft Teamsで面接を実施。帰宅時、裏庭の樹木近くに直径約1メートルの赤い球体を目撃。球体中心にバスケットボール大の白いプラズマ状の「太陽」のようなものが見えた。さらに同一の第二の赤い球体が現れ、二つは左上へ移動後、木の上方を西へ無音・滑らかに編隊のように移動し、視界から離れる際に一つに合体したか非常に接近して一つに見えた。当時の映像を撮影し文書に添付。数週間後、被面接者は西から東へ高高度を移動する複数の白い小球（腕を伸ばして持った十セント硬貨大に相当）を観察したと述べた。
summaryEn: In February 2026, FBI agents interviewed (name redacted) via Microsoft Teams. While returning home the witness observed a red orb approximately 1 meter in diameter in their backyard, with a basketball-sized white plasma-like 'sun' at its center. A second identical red orb appeared above the first; the two moved up and to the left, then west above the tree line, moving silently and smoothly in tandem (described as flying in formation or tethered) and, as they left view, merged into one or were so close they appeared as one. The witness and another person recorded video of the event, which is attached to the interview. Several weeks later the witness reported seeing multiple white orbs at much higher altitude traveling west to east, described as about the size of a dime at arm's length.
